pages.lesson:
LESSON: CREATIVE WRITING

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Writing 3.1 Guided Writing (Vocabulary) (1 session) By the end of the sub- stran
Topic 3.2: Creative Writing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Creative Writing. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Which is the hardest part of writing in a foreign language?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify elements of creative writing in a given text
2. write entertaining and informative texts in varied contexts
3. appreciate the role of creativity in writing

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: CREATIVE WRITING
This lesson teaches Creative Writing for Grade 9 GERMAN.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify elements of creative writing in a given text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. write entertaining and informative texts in varied contexts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the role of creativity in writing
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Creative Writing using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Creative Writing above.
2. Explain Creative Writing to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Creative Writing.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Creative Writing with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Creative Writing important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Which is the hardest part of writing in a foreign language?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify elements of creative writing in a given text
2. write entertaining and informative texts in varied contexts
3. appreciate the role of creativity in writing

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
